_meta.purpose: Investigative action catalog. Statutory instruments per verified research (cutoff 2026-09-06): BNSS 106 = CrPC 102 (evidentiary seizure incl. account freeze; AP HC Blue Sea Ventures 2025 caveat), BNSS 107 (attachment of proceeds), BNSS 94 = CrPC 91 (production of documents, expressly electronic), BNSS 105 (seizure with videography and panchnama), Section 63 BSA (certificate for admissibility of electronic records), 1930/CFCFRMS (I4C-run; banks execute stop-payment). Draft templates are structural placeholders — every output is labelled a DRAFT requiring IO signature and legal verification. Fill placeholders ONLY from case data; the engine refuses to invent values.
_meta.golden_hours_note: Fraud funds layer out within hours (I4C golden-hour doctrine); urgency decays exponentially with category-specific half-lives.

actions.description: Refer the complaint into 1930/CFCFRMS so banks in the money trail place stop-payment holds.
actions.statute: I4C CFCFRMS SOP (no statutory order needed)
actions.draft_template: Referral record: complaint {complaint_ref} forwarded to 1930/CFCFRMS for stop-payment across the beneficiary trail. DRAFT — verify complaint reference before transmission.

actions.description: Written order to the beneficiary bank to freeze the account during investigation.
actions.draft_template: To: The Nodal Officer, {bank_name} ({ifsc}). Order under Section 106 BNSS: freeze debits on account {account} holding approximately Rs. {amount_unwithdrawn} connected to case crime. Report to the jurisdictional Magistrate as required. DRAFT — requires IO signature and legal verification before issue.

actions.description: Attachment proceedings for traced proceeds of crime (beyond evidentiary freeze).
actions.draft_template: Application under Section 107 BNSS for attachment of proceeds in account {account} at {bank_name} ({ifsc}), approximately Rs. {amount_unwithdrawn}. DRAFT — requires IO signature and legal verification before filing.

actions.description: Requisition CDR/IPDR/tower data for an unlinked number from the service provider.
actions.statute: Section 94 BNSS (formerly Section 91 CrPC; expressly covers electronic records)
actions.draft_template: Requisition under Section 94 BNSS to the service provider: furnish CDR/IPDR for {phone} from {period_start} to {period_end} for case investigation. DRAFT — requires IO signature; route via the jurisdictional mechanism in force.

actions.description: Judicial-order tower dump for the crime window at the identified tower.
actions.draft_template: Application to the learned Magistrate for a tower dump of cell {cell_id} between {period_start} and {period_end}. DRAFT — requires IO signature and legal verification.

actions.description: Account-opening documents and photograph from the beneficiary bank.
actions.draft_template: Request to {bank_name}: furnish account-opening Customer Application Form (CAF) and KYC documents for account {account}. DRAFT — requires IO signature.

actions.description: Preserve and requisition ATM / branch CCTV surveillance footage before standard 15/30-day overwrite.
actions.draft_template: Requisition under Section 94 BNSS to {bank_name}: preserve and furnish CCTV video recordings for ATM/branch at {atm_location} during transaction timestamp {transaction_timestamp} concerning account {account}. DRAFT — requires IO signature.

actions.description: Physical seizure of mobile handset or computing hardware with mandatory videography and 2 witnesses.
actions.statute: Section 105 BNSS (Search & Seizure with videography and panchnama)
actions.draft_template: Seizure Panchnama under Section 105 BNSS: seize digital device {device_description} (IMEI/Serial: {imei_or_serial}) from possession of {suspect_name} with contemporaneous videography and two independent punch witnesses. DRAFT — requires IO signature.

actions.description: Requisition dual-signed Section 63(4) BSA certificate from service provider certifying hash and operating condition.
actions.statute: Section 63(4) BSA, 2023 (Mandatory Certificate for Electronic Evidence)
actions.draft_template: Statutory requisition under Section 63(4) BSA to {entity_name}: furnish certificate verifying SHA-256 hash, extraction date, and uncompromised operating condition of electronic record: {record_description}. DRAFT — requires IO signature.
